hero.h2: Kailua Kayak & E-Bike Adventures With Aloha
hero.subtext: Kayak in Kailua to the Mokulua Islands, Kayak in Kualoa to Mokoliʻi (Chinaman's Hat), Kayak near Kāneʻohe Bay, or Explore the jungle river of Kahana near Laie.

sections.h2: Kayak and Explore Chinaman's Hat, Kahana Bay, Kawela Bay, Kāneʻohe Bay, Kailua Bay and More
sections.intro: We make renting e-bikes, kayaks and exploring Oʻahu a breeze. Pick up kayaks and beach gear at our storefront in Kailua

features.heading: Kayak Tours
features.text: Enjoy Oʻahu's best kayaking routes with an experienced guide, or on your own terms with our pre-planned trips.

features.heading: Kayak Rentals
features.text: Rent Kayaks and other beach gear and pick them up at our shop or get them delivered to your address.

features.heading: Electric Bike Rentals & Tours
features.text: Ride the best trails and beach paths on Oʻahu with our premium e-bike fleet.

sections.quote: Great tour! It was so fun to e-bike, kayak, and see wildlife in one adventure

tours.heading: Chinaman's Hat Self-Guided Kayak Tour
tours.text: Experience ocean kayaking to Mokoliʻi on our Chinaman's Hat Self-Guided Kayak Tour*. We provide everything you need to have a great time.

tours.heading: Mokulua Islands Guided Kayak Tour, Kailuaʻs Twin Islands
tours.text: Embark on an exhilarating guided kayak tour to the Twin Islands, led by our experienced guides!
tours.imageAlt: Kayakers paddling toward the Mokulua Islands off Kailua Beach

tours.heading: Kahana Rainforest River Kayak Self-Guided Tour
tours.text: This is the Best Kayaking Experience on Oʻahu. This self-guided* Oʻahu kayak tour takes you up a calm river into the second largest valley on Oʻahu.

sections.note: We take day-of and last minute tour or rental bookings. Call us or visit our shop.

sections.heading: Kailua E-Bike Kau Kau Guided Scenic Food Tour Adventure
sections.text: Discover the highlights of Kailua as you ride, taste, and explore on our guided E-bike Kau Kau adventure!

sections.heading: Popoia Kailua's Flat Island Guided Kayak & E-Bike Adventure
sections.text: Ride, paddle, and explore on our guided e-bike and kayak adventure to Flat Island!
sections.imageAlt: Two people e-bike on the Kailua Marsh Trail

sections.heading: Mokulua Islands Kayak Adventure
sections.text: Get more info about our self-guided kayak tour out to Kailua's twin islands.
sections.imageAlt: Hiking and Kayaking Tour, epic view

categories.heading: Multi-Day
categories.text: Explore Oʻahu at your own pace with our flexible multi-day kayak and beach gear packages.

categories.heading: Self-Guided Kayak Tour
categories.text: Experience the best of Oʻahu's natural beauty on a self-guided kayak adventure.

categories.heading: Chinaman's Hat
categories.text: Paddle to Mokoliʻi and hike to the summit for panoramic views of Kāneʻohe Bay.
